scenario.note: The limit on the number of mines that may be operated per year is removed for Year1 and Year5.
The maximum number of mines that may be operated per year is removed only for Year1 and Year5, while remaining in force for other years.

The limits on the number of mines that can operate per year and the blend quality target are removed, allowing any number of mines to operate and any blend grade to be produced, as long as mass balance and capacity constraints are satisfied.
The stay-closed rule is relaxed for Year4, allowing a mine that is closed in Year4 to reopen in a later year.
The stay-closed rule is relaxed for Year4, allowing a closed mine to reopen in that year.
